document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You attempt to pick up Bernard’s trail until twilight, but your 
efforts are fruitless. You suspect that Charlie led you so far from 
the boy’s tracks that you will never find them again. You return 
to camp ready to let your guide know exactly what you think 
of her.

Charlie  is  gone,  and  so  is  the  canoe.  One  quarter  of  the 
supplies are missing.
Record the keyword BAREFOOT. Go to 95.
